meta.name: git-master
meta.description: Handles git work: atomic commits, rebase, squash, blame, bisect, reflog, and history questions. Use whenever a task needs a commit or a git-history investigation; skip for ordinary code edits.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 整理零散代码改动，变成逻辑清晰的提交记录，并追查每处修改的由来。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你每天都在提交代码，想让每次提交都有条理，也想知道某一改动是怎样来的。
copy.tagline_en: Keep a clean commit history and trace the story behind any code change.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Git daily and want clean commits and full insight into your change history.

howto.what: Claude 会按这个技能处理 git 操作:把改动拆成原子提交、做 rebase 或压缩合并、查某行或某次改动是谁在哪个提交里改的。它只执行你明确要求的动作,并报告提交哈希和验证结果。
howto.when: 当你要求提交代码,或让它查某次改动、某行为是谁在哪个提交改的等 git 历史问题时接管;普通的代码编辑不走这个技能。

say.text: 把当前改动按功能拆成几个原子提交
say.note: 会先看 diff 和最近的提交风格再分组

say.text: 帮我用 bisect 找出是哪次提交引入这个 bug
say.note: 需要能判定好坏的命令和已知的好/坏范围

say.text: 这行代码是谁在哪个提交里改的?
say.note: 会用 blame/log 查并给出提交哈希与行号

howto.what_en: Claude handles git work: splitting changes into atomic commits, rebasing or squashing history, and tracing who changed a line or which commit changed something. It runs only the operation you explicitly asked for and reports commit hashes and verification results.
howto.when_en: Use it when you ask for a commit, or for a git-history investigation such as who or which commit changed something; ordinary code edits are skipped.

say_en.text: Split my current changes into atomic commits by feature
say_en.note: It reads the diff and recent commit style first

say_en.text: Find which commit introduced this bug with bisect
say_en.note: Needs a pass/fail command and good/bad bounds

say_en.text: Who changed this line, and in which commit?
say_en.note: Uses blame/log and returns hash and line
